reviews.locator: CALCULATED from fact-ptc1b-vmax and the project's +12V nominal output rail (CLAUDE.md Project Overview; board-b PTC1 downstream of U6 L7812CD2T)
reviews.evidence_extract: Recomputed: fact-ptc1b-vmax (16 V, src-ptc1b-smd1210-datasheet Page 2 row SMD1210P150TF/16) minus the +12V nominal rail = 4 V, matching the fact's recorded value exactly. Cross-checked against the sibling fact-ptc1-vmax-margin (the superseded SMD1210P200TF/6V part on the same +12V rail), whose margin is -6 V -- a deterministic spec violation -- confirming decisions.json decision (g)'s PTC1 replacement is what turns a negative margin into this fact's positive one. Destructive risk of an under-rated PTC voltage rating: catastrophic failure (arcing/venting) under a downstream fault, rather than a safe trip.
reviews.conditions: PTC1 sits on board-b's final +12V output, so its nominal continuous applied voltage is +12V. Margin = fact-ptc1b-vmax (16 VDC) minus the 12V nominal rail voltage; the tripped-passthrough corner (U6 out of regulation, up to ~13.5V) still leaves ~2.5V, the same corner-margin class the review records as passing for PTC3's identical 16V rating.

reviews.evidence_extract: Recomputed: fact-lm2596-vin-absmax (45 V, src-lm2596-umw-ds Absolute Maximum Ratings table) minus fact-lm2596-u4-effective-input (28.5 V = 15 V board input + 13.5 V |VOUT|, bootstrapped-GND per the Inverting Regulator section) = 16.5 V, matching the fact's recorded value exactly. Destructive risk: U4's GND pin is bootstrapped to the negative output in this inverting topology, so its effective device-referred input is board input plus output magnitude, not just the +15V rail -- exceeding the 45V absolute maximum damages U4, and the margin (16.5V on a 45V limit) leaves input-side transients/ringing as a genuine open bench item, not a formality.
reviews.conditions: headroom of the 45 V absolute-maximum supply rating over the 28.5 V effective input; positive 16.5 V margin, no deterministic violation; excludes input transients/ringing, which the board-b bench scope must cover
reviews.reviewer: issue-128 worktree child (Claude Sonnet 5), foreground destructive-risk review

reviews.locator: src-cj7912-project-docs: calculated - pd-full-load x datasheet RthJA
reviews.evidence_extract: Recomputed: fact-cj7912-pd-full-load-mw (1200 mW) times fact-cj7912-rthja (100 degC/W) / 1000 = 120 degC rise, matching the fact's recorded value exactly. At Ta=25C this implies Tj ~145C, above the +125C operating junction limit in fact-cj7912-tj-operating-range, unless board-b's actual copper materially improves on the free-air-basis RthJA this calculation uses. This is a genuine destructive-risk finding surfaced, not closed, by this review: over-temperature operation degrades or destroys U8.
